paragraphs.source_en: After parting from the women at Tsuchiyama, Katagiri Katsumoto left his horse behind and entered Kyoto in a palanquin. It was the nineteenth day of the eighth month in the nineteenth year of Keichō.

paragraphs.source_en: The streets of Kyoto, so lively when Katsumoto had departed, now lay deathly still, filling him with desolation. At Sanjō Bridge, fully armed soldiers stood everywhere. Katsumoto alone felt as though he had lived through a nightmare.
